metadata.description: Community marketplace for Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Powerful task coordination and parallel execution framework. Intelligently decomposes complex tasks for concurrent execution, supporting batch operations, project-level changes, and multi-step task orchestration. Features intelligent information gathering system and Repo Wiki auto-documentation, with deep analysis from project-level to symbol-level.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Multi-role brainstorming framework. 13 professional experts debate from different perspectives, supporting intelligent recommendations and interactive selection for deep exploration of problem essence.
